content: {"like":["Values visual and auditory richness (colorful scenery, lively paintings, lovely score).","Prefers well-crafted action and choreography (crisp military choreography, sound).","Enjoys engaging, well-paced storytelling that keeps interest.","Appreciates depth and subtlety, especially in themes of reality and economics.","Values authenticity and realistic depiction of events."],"dislike":["Dislikes content that feels shallow, silly, or adds nothing to the story.","Avoids predictable or anti-climactic narratives.","Rejects poorly acted or stiff performances.","Dislikes content that is overly negative or unspeakable (e.g., murky mass murder).","Prefers original or high-quality versions over inferior modern copies."]}
